name: exia-android
description: Exia Android client — Capacitor shell wrapping the apps/web static build

scripts.sync: npm run copy-web && cap sync android
scripts.open: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
